sloka: वासाम्सि च महा अर्हाणि भूषणानि वराणि च ।वर्षाणि एतानि सम्ख्याय वैदेह्याः क्षिप्रम् आनय ॥२-३९-१५॥
transliteration: vāsāmsi ca mahā arhāṇi bhūṣaṇāni varāṇi ca ।varṣāṇi etāni samkhyāya vaidehyāḥ kṣipram ānaya ॥2-39-15॥

translations.english: Assess the (needs for) number of years the princess of Videha (Sita) is going to be in the forest, and fetch her quickly highly valuable garments and excellent ornaments.
